project.label: Playable intervention-driven worlds
project.thesis: Use playable worlds to test persistent Agent participation, communication, authority, replay, and human intervention as mechanics rather than decoration.
project.question: Which forms of play become possible when people and replaceable Agents act through one persistent World history?
owns: Station Zero product and target product decisions
Game rules and authoritative World state
boundary: Station Zero v2 is the only registered current product
Station Zero v3, Casefile, Last Light, and Echo Hunt are Game Core research treatments, not competing product stages
No new Game product is selected; canonical G0–G8 product-stage meanings remain unchanged
Long-range Game vision and research implementation create no feature or product commitment
No generic Host, Runtime, or universal Game-engine authority
project.problem: Most Agent games attach probabilistic dialogue to classical mechanics instead of making persistence, partial knowledge, communication, authority, and intervention part of play.
project.capability: Runs registered Station Zero v2 as a deterministic multi-Agent mission game while retaining several executable Game Core research treatments, including the Station Zero v3 reference experiment, Casefile, Concept Lab work, and bounded pre-G0 playable apparatus used to obtain evidence without selecting a new product.
project.maturity: Registered playable v2 product plus executable pre-G0 research treatments; no new product selected
project.audience: Players, game designers, and Agent researchers examining delegation, partial knowledge, adversarial roles, authoritative consequence, replay, and recoverable play.
project.latestProof: Current owner authority keeps station-zero@2 / station-zero-core@3 as the only registered product. Pre-G0 Wave1 materialized bounded A/D/I playable apparatus for evidence collection, while unimplemented families remain UNTESTED and C0/C1 human Player Value evidence remains unobserved; apparatus existence does not admit G0 or rank a product direction.
project.summary: Authoritative interactive worlds for people and Agents. Game keeps the registered Station Zero product separate from executable research treatments, pre-G0 apparatus, long-range possibilities, and historical product-stage evidence so implementation maturity cannot silently select the next product.
project.state: Station Zero v2 remains the registered current product. Station Zero v3, Casefile, Last Light, Echo Hunt and current pre-G0 playable work are research treatments/apparatus rather than competing product stages. No new product has been selected; human Player Value evidence remains a gate before any G0 direction admission.
